summary.text: Tracy Bricchi is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 15 who has served since December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. Ballotpedia lists her career experience as public school educator.

paragraphs.text: Bricchi also holds an office on the Merrimack Valley School District as the Penacook representative, a term that Ballotpedia says ends in 2028.
